description: Fires when the opponent threatens an immediate win in the leftmost column (a must-block landing cell in column 0), most strongly for a vertical three of their stones in column 0, weaker for a horizontal three, and barely for diagonal ones; weakened when there are other threats or late in the game. Weak firing also occurs diffusely in early openings and some must-blocks in column 5 without a clear rule.
effect: Pushes the model toward column 0: forcing it high raises column 0 by about 1-9 probability points in ordinary positions; zeroing it does not change the block when the model already plays column 0.
notes: Top 1% of activations are almost all column-0 must-blocks (vertical strongest); minimal pairs confirm column specificity (same vertical three in cols 1,3,4,6 does not fire; col 2/5 sometimes weakly). Dev F1 0.436 (P 0.61, R 0.34), AUROC 0.67; adding col-2/5 verticals or an early-opening rule did not help. About 2/3 of firing is low-level and diffuse (early openings), unexplained. Simulation share about 0 (-0.04).
